uid.description: Public identifier (UUID) of the Command. Used as a parameter in individual query (`GET /commands/{uid}`).

status.description:
Command status.

`pending`: Command not yet executed. [Initial State]
`confirmed`: Command executed and confirmed.
`failed`: Command execution failed.

resource_type.description: Type of resource to which the Command belongs (ex.: `BankBillet`, `Pix`, `Financial::Account`).

resource_uid.description: Public identifier (UUID) of the resource to which the Command belongs.

financial_provider_slug.description: Slug of the financial provider (bank) responsible for executing the Command.

payload.description: Server response with the result of the operation.

created_at.description: Date of creation of the Command record

updated_at.description: Date of update of the Command record.

confirmation_via.description:
Source of Command confirmation.

`api`: confirmed via response from the bank's API (includes webhooks, Recuperator and sync).
`edi`: confirmed via CNAB return (debit file).
`null`: No recorded source.

status.description:
Status.
`pending`: Pending. [Initial State]
`awaiting_approval`: Awaiting approval.
`confirmed`: Confirmed.
`reproved`: Disapproved.
`approved`: Approved.
`rejected`: Rejected.

registration_status.description:
Registration Status.
`pending`: Pending. [Initial State]
`requested`: Awaiting approval.
`confirmed`: Confirmed.
`rejected`: Rejected.
`failed`: Failed.

financial_account_uid.description: UID of the Origin Financial Account

transfer_account_uid.description: UID of the origin transfer account. If the transfer account was not informed, the first transfer account that was associated with the financial account was used automatically.

confirmed_at.description: Date on which Kobana processed the operation confirmation. It does not necessarily represent the date the amount left the account — for that use transaction_date.

rejected_error.description: Rejection reason returned by the bank

transaction_date.description: Official settlement/debit date informed by the bank (authentication date). Reflects when the amount actually left the account.

transfer_kind.description:
Transfer type

`pix`: Pix.
`ted`: TED.
`internal`: Between Accounts

pix.description: Pix data (Present if the `transfer_kind` field is `pix`)

pix_type.description:
Pix type

`key`: Key.
`bank_account`: Bank account data

key_type.description:
Key type (Present if the `pix_type` field is `key`)

`cpf`: CPF.
`cnpj`: CNPJ.
`random`: Random.
`email`: Email.
`phone`: Mobile phone

key.description: Pix Key (Present if the `pix_type` field is `key`)

bank_account.description: Bank account data (Present if the `transfer_kind` field is `ted`)

compe_number.description:
COMPE code of the bank.

Examples: `1` (Banco do Brasil), `237` (Bradesco), `341` (Itaú)

ispb_number.description:
ISPB code of the bank.

If not provided in the input, it will be automatically inferred from COMPE when possible.

Examples: `0` (Banco do Brasil), `60746948` (Bradesco), `60701190` (Itaú)

identifier.description:
Payment identification on the receipt from the financial provider. (Bank exclusive use)

Banks that accept this field (via API): Itaú

external_id.description: ID in your system. Optional for internal control.

custom_data.description: Hash with key and value in JSON format.
